title: Stanford Energy Seminar | The Renewables Reckoning: Bankruptcies, Buyouts, and America's Energy Supply
description: More than 100 renewable energy companies have filed for bankruptcy over the past 18 months, even as solar accounted for roughly 80% of new U.S. electricity generation last year. Nick Franchot of GoodFinch will explain what is driving the wave of distress, what it reveals about how the industry has been financed, and GoodFinch's strategy of acquiring assets out of bankruptcy.

title: Space-Based Data Centers: Will a Million Data Centers Orbit Earth?
who: Barron Nguyen, Stanford Earth and Planetary Sciences
description: SpaceX, Blue Origin, StarCloud, and Cowboy Space have proposals pending at the FCC to put more than a million data centers in space. What are the energy and sustainability implications?

title: Advancing Indigenous-Led Pathways for Just and Vibrant Communities
description: An evening dinner and discussion exploring Indigenous-led pathways for building just and vibrant communities through environmental stewardship.

title: The Electrification Trend: The Most Important Things You Need to Know
who: Dr. Diana Gragg, Managing Director, Precourt Institute for Energy
description: A short and interactive presentation on the Electrify Everything trend and its implications for the energy landscape.

title: SDSS Alumni Awards Reception
description: Join us to celebrate the 2026 SDSS Alumni Award recipients: Ross Stein, PhD '80 (Distinguished Alumni Award) and Tim Latimer, MS '17 & MBA '17, founder of Fervo Energy (Early- to Mid-Career Alumni Award).

title: Stanford Energy Seminar | Powering What's Next: Real Estate's Role in the Energy Transition
who: Susan Uthayakumar, Chief Energy & Sustainability Officer, Prologis
description: How the world's largest logistics real estate company is driving clean energy procurement, on-site solar, and energy efficiency across its global portfolio.

title: 2026 Explore Energy Expo
who: Precourt Institute for Energy / Explore Energy
description: The annual Explore Energy Expo features Stanford student clubs and professional groups doing energy-related work across campus. If you are interested in energy — from any perspective (tech, policy, research, finance, or education) — this is the event for you!

title: Energy at the Nexus: Systems, Materials, Data, and Society
description: The inaugural Precourt Institute for Energy partner convening, bringing together industry, academia, and policymakers to explore the intersections of energy systems, materials, data, and society.

title: Stanford Energy Seminar
who: Richard Newell, former CTO of Sustainability Solutions, C3 AI
